compos.text: Alt text: "ताली की सूचनाएं" (Notifications in Hindi)
Alt text: "शेयर सूचनाएं" (Share Notifications in Hindi)

Smartphone status bar displaying various icons from left to right: Facebook icon, Facebook Messenger icon, Facebook notification icon, a clock icon, a padlock icon, a battery icon, a Bluetooth icon, a Wi-Fi icon, and the current time "7:43".
Text in Hindi: "डेली सूचनाएं" which translates to "Daily Notifications" in English.
Alt text: "फोलो सूचनाएं" (Hindi text meaning "Follow notifications").
Alt text: "सूचना सेटिंग्स" (Notification Settings in Hindi)
Alt text: "Back button icon, represented by a left-pointing triangle."

compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is titled "सूचना सेटिंग्स" (Notification Settings). It displays a list of different types of notifications that can be toggled on or off. Each notification type has a switch next to it, indicating whether it is enabled (green) or disabled (grey). The types of notifications listed are:

1. फॉलो सूचनाएं (Follow Notifications) - Enabled
2. ताली की सूचनाएं (Clap Notifications) - Enabled
3. शेयर सूचनाएं (Share Notifications) - Enabled
4. कमेंट सूचनाएं (Comment Notifications) - Enabled
5. डेली सूचनाएं (Daily Notifications) - Enabled

All the notification types in this screen are currently enabled.
